text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, helps ensure that only the right people can access accounts. Developers must also validate all user input to prevent attacks like SQL injection and cross-site scripting. Common vulnerabilities, including broken access control and insecure data storage, should be checked regularly and fixed quickly. By following these basic security practices, developers can build safer websites and protect their users from serious threats.
